title: lar-spec/lar: Layered Agentic Retrieval v0.1
description: Specification draft and reference examples for Layered Agentic Retrieval (LAR), a publisher-side architectural pattern for agent-native web surfaces. Companion to the working paper, deposited open access on Zenodo (10.5281/zenodo.21622424) and on SSRN (10.2139/ssrn.6801118, identical text).
